verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a law firm's IP practice could plausibly describe its IP litigation. The pack's IP practice page only says the team handles 'a wide spectrum of IP-related matters' covering patents, trademarks, copyright and designs. It never mentions litigation, courts, venues, or case outcomes, so there is no evidence of litigated IP disputes on the firm's own pages.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages
